capabilities: rank notes by recency and visit frequency in a sidebar panel
jump to a note by clicking its row
narrow the list to the top N notes in focus mode
require a minimum open time before a visit counts
restrict or exclude tracking by folder and boost pinned notes
extras: Full scoring implementation details are in a separate SPEC.md, not the README; the plugin states it makes no network requests or telemetry.
motivation: The author says most note-taking setups bury active work under search results and folder hierarchies, and wanted attention to be visible without tags or manual curation.
problem: Obsidian buries actively-used notes under search results and folder hierarchies, with no at-a-glance view of where your attention currently is.
summary: Sidebar that ranks notes by recency and visit frequency, showing active notes as bright glowing rows and unused ones faded.
